name: Enthalpy v0.4.37
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.37

## Changes

- The Dashboard task panel now shows one list of open tasks, ordered by due
  date, with unscheduled tasks last. Completed tasks are hidden. View all
  opens the Tasks tab.
- Settings now shows General first and selects it when Settings opens.
- Type `[[` in a note to select an existing note. Suggestions show the note
  title and workspace path. Notes with the same title keep distinct links.
- Wiki links now open from Project and Area briefs, package files, and note
  previews.

## Test this preview

Open Dashboard and confirm that dated tasks appear in date order, followed
by unscheduled tasks. Complete a task and confirm that it leaves the list.
Select View all to open Tasks.

Open Settings and confirm that General is first and selected.

In an editable note, type `[[` and select a note suggestion. Confirm that
the inserted link opens the selected note. Check a wiki link in a Project
or Area brief, package file, or note preview.

## Known limits

This is a limited preview. Hosted Sync is not available. Work stays on this
device.
